prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: weapon-equipment variant of an existing production 8-direction dark fantasy ARPG character atlas.
Edit the provided Jack sprite atlas. Preserve EXACTLY the same Jack identity, black swept/spiky hair, dark eyeglasses, youthful East Asian face, teal blue sleeveless vest, rolled ivory white collared shirt, leather bracers, dark pants, boots, mature adult proportions, hand-painted/pre-rendered material detail, lighting, camera and 8 directions. This is the same character changing equipment, not a new outfit or a new character.
Change ONLY his right-hand weapon: completely REMOVE the keyboard sword in EVERY view and REPLACE it with a large, heavy, believable STAINLESS STEEL MUG used as a blunt weapon. The mug must be unmistakably an oversized silver cylindrical metal mug/tankard: thick circular open rim, brushed steel sides, stout large curved handle. He holds the mug by the handle in his RIGHT hand, down at the same relaxed combat-ready hand position. A little worn leather on the handle is fine. No hammer shaft, no sword shape, no spikes. No foam, no liquid, no writing, no labels, no logo. Rotate the same mug correctly with his physical right hand across all eight character orientations. Nothing else in his hands.
EXTREMELY IMPORTANT: there must be NO keyboard, NO keycaps, NO sword, NO blade, NO weapon on his back, and NO second weapon remaining anywhere in any cell. The steel mug is the ONLY weapon.
Packing: keep exactly FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS by TWO EQUAL ROWS, one same character rotation per invisible cell, ideal 2048x1024. Row 1 south/front, southeast, east, northeast; Row 2 north/back, northwest, west, southwest. No missing direction and no mirrored swaps. Whole body and whole mug always completely inside its own cell with generous clear transparent margins. Fixed isometric orthographic camera looking downward 40-45 degrees. Same body scale across all eight sprites. Feet at the same cell baseline. Do not crop shoes, hair, arms, glasses or mug.
Output genuinely transparent alpha. Edge pixels must be naturally colored from the artwork without a colored matte: no red, green or gray fringes, no background blocks, no checkerboard, no ground, no floor, no cast/contact shadow. No text, labels, direction markers, separators, frames, watermark, logos or scenery. Match the provided atlas's mature gritty fantasy visual quality.
delivery: Uniform per-actor scaling and transparent crop/repack only; no manual redraw. Original PNG retained in artifacts. Low-alpha matte fringes cleaned before resampling.
